frequency_question: How often do announced major financial-sector regulatory changes proceed on their originally scheduled effective date without subsequent government deferral, stay, or cancellation?
membership_rule: Includes major formally notified structural tax or fee changes in the Indian financial sector (e.g., GST rate revisions, MDR caps, new KYC/compliance mandates for fintech). Excludes minor circulars, draft guidelines open for consultation, and routine monetary policy rate changes.

cases.name: RBI auto-debit e-mandate additional factor authentication deadline (Oct 2021)
Sovereign Gold Bond issuance schedule implementations
E-invoicing mandatory threshold rollout for medium enterprises (Aug 2023)
RBI card-on-file data storage restriction deadline (Jan 2022)
UPI transaction volume cap implementation announcements (Delayed repeatedly)
LEI (Legal Entity Identifier) mandate phases for large corporate borrowers
T+1 trade settlement cycle final transition (Jan 2023)

coverage_note: 10 named cases representing major financial regulatory deadlines in India over the past decade.
known_gaps: Selection leans towards high-profile RBI and Ministry of Finance deadlines; smaller tax sub-rules might have different deferral rates.
skeleton: Not used; direct enumeration of 10 major precedent cases.
validity_reason: Regulatory policymaking styles and lobbying pressures in Indian financial administration remain stable across this medium-term horizon.
